info.title: Wink API
info.description:
Welcome to the Wink API — a programmer-friendly way to manage, sell and book travel
inventory on the Wink platform. See the **Overview** page (under **API**) for the full
introduction, intended audience, testing, and versioning.
# Payment API
Financial management for a managing entity: bank accounts, Revolut payout destinations,
withdrawals, ledger transactions, and booking revenue data.

post.description: Initiates a full-balance withdrawal to the chosen payout destination on the given managing entity. The user must specify which destination (BankAccount or RevolutPayoutAccount) to send funds to. Processed via Revolut Business; the beneficiary will receive funds within 1-3 business days for bank rails or instantly for Revolut-to-Revolut. Initial status is PENDING; the withdrawal transitions to PROCESSING once Revolut confirms, and COMPLETED when the payout arrives.

WithdrawalLightweight.description: Lightweight projection of a TripPay beneficiary withdrawal (payout) to a bank account via Revolut.

accountIdentifier.description: TripPay account identifier of the beneficiary requesting withdrawal

amount.description: Net amount sent to Revolut (grossAmount − transferFee − fxFee)

completedAt.description: When the withdrawal was completed (null until COMPLETED state)

createdDate.description: Datetime this record was first created

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the withdrawal

fxFeeAmount.description: Calculated FX exchange fee amount. Null if withdrawal currency is USD.

fxFeeRate.description: FX exchange fee rate (0.006 or 0.010). Null if withdrawal currency is USD.

grossAmount.description: Full available balance before fees are deducted

lastUpdate.description: Datetime this record was last updated

referenceCode.description: Human-readable reference shown on bank statements

revolutPaymentId.description: Revolut transaction ID returned by the Revolut Business API

status.description: Current status of the withdrawal lifecycle

transferFeeAmount.description: Revolut flat transfer fee ($5 USD converted to withdrawal currency)

version.description: Optimistic-locking version. Echo this value back as an If-Match request header on a conditional update; the server responds 409 if the record changed in the meantime. Null when this projection has no backing versioned document, in which case no conditional update is possible.

AggregateDescriptor.description: Descriptor that defines an aggregate function to apply to a specific field in a grouped result set.

field.description: Field to run aggregate function on

CompositeFilterDescriptor.description: Top-level filter container that combines one or more field-level filter descriptors using a logical operator.

filters.description: Descriptors used for filtering the result set

logic.description: Whether to filter inclusively or exclusively

FilterDescriptor.description: A single field-level filter criterion that specifies what to match and how to compare it.

ignoreCase.description: Make filter comparison case insensitive. Default: Case sensitive

operator.description: Filter operator to use on field

GroupDescriptor.description: Descriptor that defines how a result set should be grouped, including sort direction and optional aggregate calculations.

field.description: Field to group data set on

SortDescriptor.description: Descriptor that defines the sort direction and field for ordering a result set.

dir.description: Descriptors used for sorting result set

field.description: Data set field to sort on

State.description: Pagination, sorting, filtering, and grouping state used to query a paged result set.

filter.description: Descriptors used for filtering result set

group.description: Descriptors to group result sets by.

skip.description: Number of records to be skipped by the pager.

sort.description: Descriptors used for sorting result set.

Bed.description: A single bed type and its quantity within a bedroom, described using the OpenTravel bed type code.

bedTypeCode.description: OpenTravel bed type code (e.g., 1=Double, 2=Twin, 7=Queen, 8=King). See [OTA geoname data](#operation/showAvailableCodesForCategory).

quantity.description: Number of beds of this type in the room.

Bedroom.description: A single bedroom within a room type, specifying the bedroom type and its bed configuration.

bedList.description: List of bed configurations for this bedroom. Each entry specifies a bed type and quantity.

type.description: Bedroom type classification (e.g., MASTER, QUEEN, JUNIOR, DORMITORY, BEDROOM_1...BEDROOM_10).

BedroomConfiguration.description: A named bedroom layout configuration for a room type, containing one or more bedrooms each with their own bed setup.

bedroomList.description: List of bedrooms within this configuration layout.

identifier.description: Unique identifier for this bedroom configuration layout.

name.description: Human-readable name of this room layout configuration.

Beneficiary.description: A beneficiary is a registered account entitled to a portion of booking funds. Funds are allocated by type (SALE, COMMISSION, PLATFORM_FEE, etc.) and tracked across source, display, and internal (platform) currencies. Refund modifiers record adjustments from cancellations.

accountEmail.description: Contact email address for the beneficiary account

accountIdentifier.description: Unique identifier of the beneficiary's account in the TripPay system

accountName.description: Display name of the beneficiary account (e.g. hotel, affiliate, or platform name)

accountUrl.description: Profile or dashboard URL for the beneficiary account

amountDue.description: Charge rule: either a fixed percentage of the total stay or the remainder after other beneficiaries are deducted

displayAmount.description: Gross amount owed to this beneficiary in display currency (before refunds)

displayAmountRefundModifier.description: Cumulative refund reduction applied to displayAmount (sum of all applied PendingRefunds)

displayCurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for display to the user (e.g. booking shown in USD)

internalAmount.description: Gross amount owed to this beneficiary in internal currency (before refunds)

internalAmountRefundModifier.description: Cumulative refund reduction applied to internalAmount (sum of all applied PendingRefunds)

internalCurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for internal platform ledger (always USD)

metadata.description: Additional key-value metadata for the beneficiary (e.g. bank details, supplier identifiers)

netDisplayAmount.description: Net amount owed in display currency (displayAmount - displayAmountRefundModifier)

netInternalAmount.description: Net amount owed in internal currency (internalAmount - internalAmountRefundModifier)

netSourceAmount.description: Net amount owed in source currency (sourceAmount - sourceAmountRefundModifier)

items.description: Pending refunds awaiting settlement. Once a refund transitions from PENDING to APPLIED, it moves out of this list and into the corresponding *AmountRefundModifier property

reconciled.description: Flag indicating whether net amounts have been transferred (disbursed) from TripPay to the beneficiary

sourceAmount.description: Gross amount owed to this beneficiary in source currency (before refunds)

sourceAmountRefundModifier.description: Cumulative refund reduction applied to sourceAmount (sum of all applied PendingRefunds)

sourceCurrency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the originating source (supplier's local currency, e.g. hotel in Thailand uses THB)

type.description: Category of the beneficiary: SALE (property), COMMISSION (affiliate), PLATFORM_FEE (Wink), TRIP_PAY (platform internal), or agency fees

BeneficiaryCharge.description: Defines how a beneficiary's slice of the booking is calculated: either as a fixed percentage of the total stay price, or as the remainder after other beneficiaries have taken their share.

percent.description: The percentage value (0.0–1.0) to apply to the total booking amount when type=PERCENTAGE. For example, 0.050 = 5% of the booking price. Ignored when type=REMAINDER.

type.description: PERCENTAGE: apply the percent field to the total booking price. REMAINDER: this beneficiary receives whatever is left after other beneficiaries are satisfied (typically used for the hotel).

oauth2ClientCredentials.description:
Every endpoint is protected with OAuth2 **client credentials**. Create an
**Application** in your account to obtain a `clientId` and `clientSecret`, then
exchange them for a short-lived bearer token.

### 1. Request an access token
`POST` to the **Token URL** below with `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
and a body of `grant_type=client_credentials` (optionally `scope=<space-separated scopes>`).
Send your credentials as HTTP Basic auth:
`Authorization: Basic base64(clientId + ":" + clientSecret)`.

### 2. Call the API
Pass the returned token on every request: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

Tokens carry only the scopes granted to your Application — request the least privilege
you need. There is no interactive authorize step and no refresh token for this flow;
request a new token when the current one expires.
